title: In Honor of Ariana Grande’s Birthday, Which of Her Billboard Hot 100 No. 1s Is Your Favorite? Vote!
summary: The star has had 10 tracks top the chart to date.
contentText:
Ariana Grande is saying thank u, next to another trip around the sun. And to celebrate, Billboard wants to know which of her numerous Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hits you think takes the (birthday) cake.

Related

Everything We Know About Ariana Grande’s ‘Petal’ (So Far)

Ariana Grande Announces Full ‘Petal’ Tracklist

Ariana Grande’s Eternal Sunshine Tour 2026 Setlist: Every Song Played at the First Show

The multi-hyphenate pop superstar turned 33 years old on Friday (June 26), right in the middle of an exciting summerlong tour supporting her 2024 Billboard 200 -topping album, Eternal Sunshine . Each night’s show on the trek has included many of the 10 total hits she’s had grace the summit of the Hot 100 so far, including “Yes, And?” and “We Can’t Be Friends (Wait for Your Love)” from the two-year-old LP as well as older smashes such as “7 Rings,” “Thank U, Next” and “Positions.”

On the road, she’s also been performing “Hate That I Made You Love Me,” the lead single from upcoming eighth album Petal that topped the U.S. songs chart earlier in June ahead of the LP’s arrival. But those aforementioned solo smashes on her setlist make up just over half of her Hot 100 chart-toppers, four of which are unforgettable collaborations with other artists. There’s her pandemic-era duets with Justin Bieber and Lady Gaga — “Stuck With U” and “Rain on Me,” respectively, as well as her features on go-to collaborator The Weeknd’s “Save Your Tears” and “Die for You.”

But which of those No. 1s outshines the rest? In honor of the Wicked actress’ 33rd year of life, Billboard wants to know. Tell us your favorite of Grande’s Hot 100-topping hits by casting your vote in the poll below.
